sourceEvidence.title: Quality Control Manager
sourceEvidence.location: Salt Lake City, UT 84116, United States
sourceEvidence.quote:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
• Own and deliver site-level quality KPIs, including inspection accuracy, turnaround time, defect rates, and compliance
• Drive a results-oriented culture and implement corrective actions to meet or exceed performance targets
• Manage and prioritize QC team workload to ensure timely and accurate execution of all quality activities
• Lead and oversee all inspection activities (incoming, in-process, and final) to ensure adherence to product specifications and standards
• Maintain ownership of quality systems, including documentation, reporting, and Non-Conforming Material (NCMR) processes
• Ensure consistent execution of inspection plans and quality procedures across the site
• Lead implementation and sustainment of ISO 9001:2015 standards and ensure audit readiness
